normalSpeedPolicy: User instructed default 1x playback unless unusually slow motion is suspected; not an independently verified physical clock.
alignment: FC=0%, BR=100%; PKH=-100% only when reviewed and observed. Otherwise pre-contact window spans one FC-to-BR duration and is not a knee-lift event. Strong automatic image events align previews only; headline statistics require source-reviewed events. Missing event pairs remain in clip time. No wrist-speed substitution.

segmentDefinitions.pelvis: Signed angular velocity about inferred vertical of calibrated model pelvis frame
segmentDefinitions.trunk: Signed angular velocity about inferred vertical of calibrated model thorax frame
segmentDefinitions.elbow: Elbow extension angular velocity, not humeral internal rotation
